facts: Constitution 1.1.0 (specs/constitution.md, approval specs/constitution.approval.json) is adopted for this change.
Phase 1 (004-report-core) provides the workspaces, machines and agent_sessions tables (migration 018) and the pure workspace object projection toWorkspaceView in src/services/workspace-view.ts.
Phase 2 (004-feature-core) provides resolveFeatureId, createFeature and setFeatureStage in src/services/feature-service.ts and featureDefaults/isFeatureStage in src/services/feature-rules.ts.
workspaces.feature_id references entities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, and (machine_id, path) is unique.
Visibility (FR-040): a linked workspace follows its feature task's visibility and the task type permission; an unlinked workspace is personal.
Decisions D1-D13 and the 10-slice plan accepted by Ivo on 2026-11-01; D8 and D9 are controller details that follow FR-040.
The services become reachable through new REST route files and MCP tools (contracts/rest.md 123-343, contracts/mcp.md), registered by createApp in src/index.ts.
